name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 141 drones 17–18 Nov; 5 killed in a day
summary: Russian attacks killed five and injured 15 across Ukraine in the day to 18 Nov, hitting energy sites in three regions
state: Russian attacks killed five people and injured 15 across Ukraine in the day to 18 Nov, damaging energy infrastructure in Kyiv, Mykolaiv and Rivne oblasts; a strike in Rivne cut power to more than 80 settlements (Kyiv Independent). Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 141 drones overnight into 18 Nov and 126 were downed (Ukrinform). This follows the 17 Nov missile strike on Kyiv's Dnipro bridges. Sustained mass strikes on infrastructure keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy sites can cause power and heating cuts as winter sets in.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on energy infrastructure (141 drones, 18 Nov) = significant escalation, Alert
